entries.reason: Half of how the people of a society of things fared, as the third score reads it: how much of the need that waiting would leave above the threshold the scored people were spared, as a share of what their own routine spares them on the same seed. Every being of a society of things carries the purposeful need, so U is the need above the routine's threshold summed over the scored people's person-minutes, read from every minute's state, and the term is (U of waiting minus U of this run) over (U of waiting minus U of the routine), so waiting scores 0 and the routine 1 and nothing is clipped. It reads states alone.

entries.reason: The other half: how many different kinds of thing each scored person did in the hour. A kind is one of the routine's own activities a minute's state names while the person is doing something (resting, visiting, standing, talking), never walking or waiting, or an act the society's modules record for that person by an event whose subject did it: a line said, a thing picked up, put down, given or taken. A line does not change what its speaker is doing and a hands act is recorded only by its event, so no kind counts twice, and each kind counts once per person, so saying many lines adds one kind. V is the count summed over the scored people and the term is (V of this run minus V of waiting) over (V of the routine minus V of waiting) on the same seed, so waiting scores 0 and the routine 1 and nothing is clipped; the routine never speaks or uses its hands, so a model that also does scores above 1. It reads the minutes and those act events, never a decision's event: no answer, answer time, receipt or disposition reaches it.

entries.reason: The scored people's turns whose choice the minute applied: the model decided them. Read from the decision_applied events the engine appends, by disposition. Each reliability count is reported beside the score in two forms, never weighed: as a share of the run's own turns, and per choice point the routine had for the same people on the same seed, a count recorded by the routine's own run before any model run of that seed starts. Where everybody outside the group follows their routine, as a judged comparison requires, that run asks nobody, so no model's answers move the count.

entries.reason: The share of the scored people's person-minutes spent where they are with nothing under way. Waiting is an allowed action, so this is reported rather than penalised: a model that waits a great deal shows it here and pays for it only through the need it leaves unmet.
